reasoning: UNSATISFIABLE. For any off-diagonal pair i != j, Latin + idempotence implies x[i][j] is neither i nor j, and x[j][i] is neither i nor j. Also x[i][j] != x[j][i], otherwise the QG3 constraint would force an impossible diagonal value. Thus each unordered pair {i,j} is mapped by QG3 to a distinct disjoint unordered pair {x[i][j], x[j][i]}, and applying QG3 again maps it back. So the 15 unordered off-diagonal pairs of a 6-element set would need to be partitioned into 2-cycles. Since 15 is odd, this is impossible.
